<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0032026-03-0217-11-33" status="unreviewed">dang po la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsha ba</rs></note> na re sgrub bya'i mtshan gzhi ni la me ldan dang sgra mi rtag pa'i don spyi kun brtags yin gyis dngos po la byas na phyogs chos dang 'dra ba dang mi 'dra ba ni mthun phyogs mi mthun phyogs kyi <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> yin pas | la me ldan gyi dngos po rang nyid la 'dra ba'i yul dang 'dra byed b med pas mi mthun phyogs su 'gyur la 'dod na de la du ba'i
               <lb edRef="inst:5508" n="84b6"/>zhugs pas du bas me sgrub ldog med kyi shes pa yod la | don spyi dang la me ldan 2 pas mthun phyogs la du bzhugs pas ji skad smos pa'i nyes pa med pa'o || zhes zer ba ni ma yin te |</seg></TEI>
